versions.content: The Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated_EventActivation shall return TRUE if • the Resource Entry in the Binary Manifest created according to [SWS_SwCluC_03126] or [SWS_SwCluC_03136] is connected AND  the occurrence of a send operation was indicated after previous calls of this instance of the Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated_EventActivation OR  a enqueue operation occurred after previous calls of this instance of the Rte_Rips_DataIsUpdated_EventActivation
